name: abuse.ch Feodo Tracker — Botnet C2 IPs
_note: Command-and-control IPs for Emotet/QakBot/Dridex families. Tiny and currently dormant upstream (last refreshed 2026-03-04), but the entries are real and stable, which makes them dependable fixtures for enrichment tests. Column 2 is dst_ip.

name: abuse.ch ThreatFox — Recent IOCs
_note: The workhorse feed: refreshed continuously and the only curated source here that carries all four IOC classes at once (domains, ip:port, URLs, md5/sha1/sha256). Column 3 is ioc_value.

name: abuse.ch URLhaus — Recent Malware URLs
_note: Live malware-distribution URLs from the trailing 30 days. Correlation is disabled on purpose: this is the largest feed here (~17k rows) and MISP's correlation engine is quadratic in attribute count, which would bloat the DB on a laptop. restSearch — the lookup Wazuh actually uses for enrichment — is unaffected. Column 3 is the URL.

name: abuse.ch MalwareBazaar — Recent Sample Hashes
_note: MD5 hashes of recently submitted malware samples. Single-column plain text, so no column index is given; the exclude regex drops the '#' banner lines. This is the feed that makes file-hash enrichment possible against Wazuh's file-integrity events.
